Mixed purées

Carrot and Jerusalem artichoke

Csicsókás répa

8 months+ Adjusted 30 min 4 portions

Start at eight months with a small serving. The artichoke is only a small part of the bowl.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 300 g carrots (peeled weight, the main vegetable)
  • 40 g Jerusalem artichoke (a small piece only, peeled, because more can cause gas)
  • 2 tsp olive oil (stirred in at the end)

Allergens

none

Method

  1. Peel the carrots and the small piece of Jerusalem artichoke.
  2. Cut them into chunks and boil in unsalted water until very soft.
  3. Blend until smooth, with a spoon of cooking water if needed.
  4. Stir in the olive oil at the end.
  5. Do not add a stock cube or salt.

Adjusted

Jerusalem artichoke can cause painful gas if the portion is large. A stock cube is salty and does not belong in the pot.

Use mostly carrot and only a small piece of Jerusalem artichoke. Stir in olive oil at the end, start at 8 months, and do not use a stock cube.
